modelAnswer:
Let the bisector of angle A meet BC at M. In the isosceles triangle AB = AC.
Right triangles ABM and ACM share hypotenuse-free legs AM, equal angles at A, and equal sides

So the angle bisector of A is exactly the right bisector of BC.
